Health Connect is optional. These permissions let Caffeine Health connect your caffeine log and sleep information on this device.
Nutrition access lets the app write the caffeine amount, drink name and time from your log to Health Connect, and read caffeine records from other apps into your log and estimates.
Hydration access lets the app write the volume and time of eligible drinks you log to Health Connect.
Sleep access lets the app read sleep sessions to estimate your bedtime and support Coach calculations. The app does not write sleep records.

Imported caffeine entries are stored in the local app database. Health Connect data is used on this device, not sent to a Caffeine Health server or used for advertising. A backup you export can include imported caffeine entries; you choose where that file is saved.

You can disconnect in Settings → Health Connect or revoke individual permissions in Android Health Connect settings. Disconnecting stops further access; existing local log entries and records already written to Health Connect are not automatically removed. Delete local entries in the app and manage Health Connect records in Android settings.
